messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: reserved-pool 'dedicated-enterprise-eu-1' utilization = 100% (gpu_count=128/128). queue depth rising for reserved tenants. autoscaler errors seen. paging oncall-sre

oncall-sre: Got the page, joining. Checking autoscaler logs and current pool state.

elaine: seeing large tail of queued requests for tenant 'OrchidBank' and some noisy ff-workloads sticky on GPUs. Customer impact reported: elevated latencies and 429s.

miguel: I see repeated autoscaler failures: "scale_up rejected: quota_limit" in controller logs. Also a flurry of retries from best-effort jobs.

oncall-sre: paste of recent error snippet:
```
2026-03-15T03:12:09Z controller: scale_up request for pool dedicated-enterprise-eu-1 -> 16 gpus
2026-03-15T03:12:09Z controller: allocate_quota failed: quota_exceeded(project=redwood-prod-eu, limit=128)
2026-03-15T03:12:09Z autoscaler: fallback_delay=30s, retry=3
```

sarah: customer bridge prep — OrchidBank SRE oncall is pinged. They see degraded inference for high-priority models. Can we get a mitigation that avoids customer-visible 429s?

jon: two quick options: 1) evict best-effort / lower-priority sessions on the pool, 2) route OrchidBank to a smaller model variant temporarily (quantized v2) that fits into available slots. Which is faster?

miguel: eviction is fastest. We have a label on workloads: priority=best-effort. I can push an eviction policy to drain those. Command: `resvctl drain --pool dedicated-enterprise-eu-1 --selector priority=best-effort --grace 30s`

elaine: +1 on eviction. Also we should enable autoscaler soft-override to bypass cloud quota check while infra confirms quota bump. That gives headroom if cloud quota is being released.

infra-bot: NOTE: quota bump requests require manual approval in cloud console. Current pending request id: Q-98122 (submitted 03:05Z).

oncall-sre: Execute eviction now, and start Canary route for OrchidBank to the quantized model. Sarah, can you coordinate the customer reroute?

sarah: On it. I'll open a bridge and tell OrchidBank we have a mitigation path. Starting canary: route 10% -> model:robin-quant-v2.

jon: I'll run the eviction step. Logs:
```
$ resvctl drain --pool dedicated-enterprise-eu-1 --selector priority=best-effort --grace 30s
Draining 24 sessions... evicted 18, 6 pending (sticky preemptions)
Cache cleared for 18 sessions, reclaimed 36 GPUs
```

miguel: After eviction, pool utilization dropped to 72% (92/128). Queue depth decreased but still some tail due to slow retries. Autoscaler still reporting quota_exceeded when trying to provision additional ephemeral nodes.

oncall-sre: For immediate relief, apply routing rule to redirect low-latency but non-critical routes to hosted fallback tier (hosted-api eu-west) for up to 5 minutes. That should reduce spikes.

elaine: Applied routing rule: `routectl set-policy --pool dedicated-enterprise-eu-1 --fallback hosted-eu --threshold 80% --duration 300s` — confirmed active.

sarah: OrchidBank oncall acknowledged. They're seeing latency drop after canary. They're ok with a brief fallback to hosted while infra resolves quota. Opening a customer bridge and adding them.

oncall-sre: Next: implement temporary throttling for noisy tenants that are within reserved but spiky. We can add rate-limit config: `per-tenant qps cap` for best-effort and burst sessions.

miguel: Pushing throttle: `rtctl update-tenant --tenant noisy-tenant-42 --qps 2 --burst 4` -> applied. Already reduced noisy fan-out.

infra-bot: Cloud quota Q-98122 now marked 'approved' at 03:22Z, but physical resource allocation pending (~6-8 minutes).

jon: Autoscaler re-attempting scale, got new allocation success for +8 GPUs at 03:29Z. Pool utilization now 64% (84/132). Queue drained to baseline.

elaine: Confirmed OrchidBank errors dropped to baseline, no customer-facing 5xx or 429 during bridge. We kept them on the bridge for 10 minutes during stabilization.

sarah: Customer bridge summary: OrchidBank impacted (inference latency > 2x) for ~18 minutes. Mitigations: eviction of best-effort jobs, canary model reroute (10%), routing fallback to hosted-eu, per-tenant throttle for noisy tenant. No SLA breaches expected; flagged for post-incident review.

oncall-sre: Action items assigned: miguel -> write up autoscaler quota-handling playbook (how to handle quota_exceeded and soft-override), jon -> add longer-term eviction automation for priority=best-effort when reserved pools hit 90% for >5mins, elaine -> coordinate postmortem and customer note.

miguel: note: need to improve autoscaler backoff logic — currently it bails on quota errors for 10m which prevented quick retry after small quota release. I'll add ticket.

elaine: Creating postmortem doc and filing RCA ticket now. Also tagging Capacity & Sales for any customer comms.

jon: small follow-up: we saw 6 stuck sessions that required manual kill due to stale gRPC streams. I'll add a probe to detect stuck sessions older than 120s and surface a removable flag.

sarah: Thanks team. I'll keep the bridge open until infra confirms all provisioned nodes healthy and OrchidBank confirms steady state.

oncall-sre: Closing pager for now, leaving monitoring on for 30m. If utilization climbs back above 85% we re-open incident. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (eviction, throttles, fallback routing). status=stabilized. incident-id=INC-3924671122.

elaine: Post-incident notes will include timeline, commands used, and recommended follow-ups (autoscaler retry behavior, eviction automation, customer routing playbooks).

miguel: cc @infra-bot for follow-up on quota automation with cloud provider.

sarah: I'll draft the customer-facing timeline and share for review.

jon: leaving some commands in runbook channel after cleanup. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
